verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec file. What it does show is adjacent: a pre-configured Postman workspace for exploring endpoints, an llms.txt documentation index, Markdown versions of doc pages, and SDKs. None of these is documented as a downloadable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
